about: The one setting for the moving pictures' recorded voice. Change `voice` (a stock voice of the speech model, never a copy of a real person's voice) and run `node scripts/build-film-audio.mjs --all` to make every file again; `--check` fails until the files match. `speed` is the engine speed that lands this voice near 137 words a minute with its pauses; `gaps` are the pauses in seconds; `respell` changes only what the engine is given to say, never the site's text.
